name: codex-auto-retry
description: Automatically resumes Codex tasks after recoverable provider failures, with a Windows tray controller and an embedded Codex panel.

interface.shortDescription: Recover interrupted tasks with tray and Codex controls.
interface.longDescription: Runs a local, provider-independent watchdog that detects explicit provider failures and silent empty responses, then resumes the same task through a shared Codex app-server without adding a visible user message, focusing the App, or switching tasks. A Windows tray controller and embedded Codex panel show live countdowns, bounded controller health, separate per-fault and consecutive no-progress limits, fixed, linear, or doubling waits, queue state, pause controls, and retry settings.
defaultPrompt: 開啟 Codex Auto Retry 管理面板。
檢視自動重試佇列和倒數計時。
